chunking.method: section-aware: split at Markdown headings (##, ###), pack paragraphs/lists/tables up to a word limit, repeat table headers when a table is split
chunking.embedded_text: document title | heading path + section text

lexical.method: BM25 (k1=1.4, b=0.75), built from chunks.jsonl at load time

retrieval.fusion: reciprocal rank fusion (k=60) of dense and BM25 rankings
retrieval.permission_filter: chunks outside the caller's role are removed before ranking
retrieval.no_evidence_rule: return no_relevant_evidence when the best permitted dense score is below min_dense_score
